title: DRC Launches Ebola Vaccination Campaign for Frontline Workers in Kisangani
detail: DRC's Minister of Public Health launched an ERVEBO vaccine immunization campaign for frontline health workers in Kisangani on Aug 27, targeting the outbreak's spread into Tshopo, Bas-Uele and Haut-Uele provinces. The same day's WHO/ECDC situation update, reflecting data through Aug 26, put the Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak at 5,794 confirmed cases and 2,786 deaths — up 81 cases and 42 deaths from the prior report — with 843 patients hospitalized in isolation and roughly 60 of 151 health zones across six provinces affected.

sources.name: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control
